metrics.label: KPIs y contrato de datos
metrics.lesson: Una métrica debe tener una sola definición reutilizable y comprobable.

44  def validate_sales_data(
  45      sales: pd.DataFrame,
  46      products: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
  47      clients: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
  48      events: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
  49  ) -> DataQualityReport:
  50      """Validate the transaction fact table and optional dimensions."""
  51  
  52      missing_columns = sorted(REQUIRED_SALES_COLUMNS - set(sales.columns))
  53      checks: dict[str, bool] = {
  54          "required_columns": not missing_columns,
  55          "non_empty": not sales.empty,
  56      }
  57      details: dict[str, Any] = {"missing_columns": missing_columns}
  58  
  59      if missing_columns:
  60          return DataQualityReport(False, len(sales), checks, details)
  61  
  62      checks.update(
  63          {
  64              "unique_transaction_ids": not sales["transaccion_id"].duplicated().any(),
  65              "positive_quantities": bool((sales["cantidad"] > 0).all()),
  66              "non_negative_revenue": bool((sales["ingreso_total"] >= 0).all()),
  67              "non_negative_profit": bool((sales["utilidad_bruta"] >= 0).all()),
  68              "valid_months": bool(sales["mes"].between(1, 12).all()),
  69          }
  70      )
  71  
  72      if products is not None:
  73          orphan_products = int((~sales["producto_id"].isin(products["producto_id"])).sum())
  74          checks["product_references"] = orphan_products == 0
  75          details["orphan_products"] = orphan_products
  76      if clients is not None:
  77          orphan_clients = int((~sales["cliente_id"].isin(clients["cliente_id"])).sum())
  78          checks["client_references"] = orphan_clients == 0
  79          details["orphan_clients"] = orphan_clients
  80      if events is not None:
  81          orphan_events = int(
  82              (sales["evento_id"].notna() & ~sales["evento_id"].isin(events["evento_id"])).sum()
  83          )
  84          checks["event_references"] = orphan_events == 0
  85          details["orphan_events"] = orphan_events
  86  
  87      details["nulls"] = {
  88          column: int(count)
  89          for column, count in sales.isna().sum().items()
  90          if count and column not in {"evento_id", "campana"}
  91      }
  92      checks["no_unexpected_nulls"] = not details["nulls"]
  93      return DataQualityReport(all(checks.values()), len(sales), checks, details)
  94  
  95  
  96  def compute_kpis(sales: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, float | int]:
  97      """Return KPI definitions shared by every interface."""
  98  
  99      if sales.empty:
 100          return {
 101              "revenue": 0.0,
 102              "gross_profit": 0.0,
 103              "weighted_margin_pct": 0.0,
 104              "transactions": 0,
 105              "units": 0,
 106              "average_ticket": 0.0,
 107          }
 108  
 109      revenue = float(sales["ingreso_total"].sum())
 110      profit = float(sales["utilidad_bruta"].sum())
 111      return {
 112          "revenue": round(revenue, 2),
 113          "gross_profit": round(profit, 2),
 114          "weighted_margin_pct": round((profit / revenue * 100) if revenue else 0, 2),
 115          "transactions": int(len(sales)),
 116          "units": int(sales["cantidad"].sum()),
 117          "average_ticket": round(float(sales["ingreso_total"].mean()), 2),
 118      }

# ... fragmento intermedio omitido ...

 121  def compute_dynamic_insights(sales: pd.DataFrame) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
 122      """Build descriptive insights for the currently selected slice.
 123  
 124      These statements deliberately avoid causal and ROI claims. The source data
 125      is synthetic and does not include campaign cost or an experimental control.
 126      """
 127  
 128      if sales.empty:
 129          return [{"title": "Sin datos", "finding": "Amplía los filtros para analizar resultados."}]
 130  
 131      kpis = compute_kpis(sales)
 132      revenue = float(kpis["revenue"])
 133      month_revenue = sales.groupby("mes")["ingreso_total"].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
 134      product_revenue = sales.groupby("nombre_producto")["ingreso_total"].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
 135      channel = sales.groupby("canal_venta").agg(
 136          revenue=("ingreso_total", "sum"), profit=("utilidad_bruta", "sum")
 137      )
 138      channel["margin"] = channel["profit"].div(channel["revenue"]).mul(100)
 139  
 140      top_month = int(month_revenue.index[0])
 141      top_product = str(product_revenue.index[0])
 142      top_channel = str(channel["margin"].idxmax())
 143      campaign_sales = sales[sales["campana"].notna()]
 144      non_campaign_sales = sales[sales["campana"].isna()]
 145  
 146      insights = [
 147          {
 148              "title": "Concentración temporal",
 149              "finding": f"El mes {top_month} aporta {month_revenue.iloc[0] / revenue * 100:.1f}% del ingreso seleccionado.",
 150          },
 151          {
 152              "title": "Producto líder",
 153              "finding": f"{top_product} concentra {product_revenue.iloc[0] / revenue * 100:.1f}% del ingreso.",
 154          },
 155          {
 156              "title": "Margen por canal",
 157              "finding": f"{top_channel} registra el mayor margen ponderado ({channel.loc[top_channel, 'margin']:.1f}%).",
 158          },
 159      ]
 160  
 161      if not campaign_sales.empty and not non_campaign_sales.empty:
 162          uplift = (
 163              campaign_sales["ingreso_total"].mean() / non_campaign_sales["ingreso_total"].mean() - 1
 164          ) * 100
 165          insights.append(
 166              {
 167                  "title": "Asociación con campañas",
 168                  "finding": f"El ticket observado durante campañas es {uplift:+.1f}% frente a periodos sin campaña; es asociación, no ROI y no causalidad.",
 169              }
 170          )
 171      return insights
